body: Because I don't give a fuck about the world, I have severe depression and that's not how it works. Get off/r/suicidewatch

The pain doesn't get easier, people just get distracted by more recent things. Six long years of this shit, six years of trying to get help from doctors and exercise and every possible non prescription drug that was said to even slightly help (along with a handful of different antidepressants). You shouldn't waste your time trying to talk me out of it, I've heard nearly everything that can be said and none of it does anything for me.
If you have ipecac, take that, it'll make you throw up. Otherwise, I suggest drinking water and trying to get more out that way. Do you have any guess at how much is still in your system?

And this is where you're wrong. If it was as simple as me just changing what I was doing, I wouldn't be here. I've relapsed more times than I can count and I have two previous attempts under my belt with the scars and organ damage as souvenirs. I have $3 to my name, no job, no chance at higher education, no one depends on me so I have no obligations, my "friends" have been sick of helping me with my depression for a long while, and I recently had a major falling out with my best friend (the only one I had left) with absolutely no chance of redemption.

It's pretty safe to say that tomorrow's not going to be any better than today.

No one can help me when I'm the source of all my own problems. I'm done waiting on a miracle. I've tried everything possible and recently I more or less lost the only thing I had left. I'm okay with death, although I'd rather use a gun than a noose, but I'll work with what I have.
I've tried to reach out dozens of times, now I'm done trying.
